steps.description: Vendor Risk team administers the security questionnaire to the vendor.

evidence.quote: security questionnaire administered by the Vendor Risk team

steps.description: Vendor Risk scores the questionnaire. Score >=80 routes directly to PII check; score 60-79 routes to compensating controls review; score <60 results in immediate rejection.

evidence.quote: A score of 80 or above passes the vendor directly to contract negotiation. A score between 60 and 79 requires a compensating controls review before the vendor may proceed to contract. A score below 60 results in immediate rejection of the vendor.

steps.description: Vendor Risk conducts a compensating controls review for vendors scoring 60-79. Vendors scoring below 60 are rejected.

evidence.quote: A score between 60 and 79 requires a compensating controls review before the vendor may proceed to contract. A score below 60 results in immediate rejection of the vendor.

steps.description: Vendor Risk formally rejects the vendor due to an insufficient security score.

evidence.quote: A score below 60 results in immediate rejection of the vendor.

steps.description: Legal determines whether the vendor handles PII. If yes, a DPA must be executed before contract. If no, proceed directly to contract issuance.

evidence.quote: Vendors that handle personally identifiable information (PII) must execute a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with Legal before any contract is countersigned.

steps.description: Legal executes the Data Processing Agreement with the vendor before countersigning the contract.

evidence.quote: must execute a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with Legal before any contract is countersigned

steps.description: Procurement issues the vendor contract for signature after all required reviews and agreements are complete.

evidence.quote: The Procurement team issues the vendor contract for signature only after all required reviews and agreements are complete.
